baseline_identity.why_svg_excluded: preview.svg is stored as reference material only, NOT a byte-identity assertion. Root cause fully pinpointed (not just inferred): vpype's SVG writer embeds a Dublin Core <dc:date> metadata timestamp at generation wall-clock time. A job_id-verified fresh replay against this same settings.json was diffed line-by-line against this checkpoint's preview.svg: all 5450 lines, all 5172 path/polyline elements, all 1,665,375 points-attribute characters, and the byte length (1818788) were IDENTICAL; the ONLY differing line was <dc:date>. G-code has no equivalent metadata field, which is why gcode SHA-256 is byte-stable across every run in this investigation while SVG SHA-256 never matched twice. See artifacts/rebaseline-2026-07-11/discriminators.json (root_cause_pinpointed) and golden_tests/expected/README.md.
